info.description: Public snapshots and working revisions are separate. All content domains share lifecycle/receipts. Credentials never grant admin or protected-field approval. Concrete resource paths define strict create and partial PATCH contracts. Nested safety/template validation also applies; GET resources advertises top-level field rules.

clientBasic.description: OAuth client ID and secret, individually form-URL-encoded before joining with colon.

ResourceData.description: Exact resource schema selected by resource path

ResourcePatch.description: Use the concrete resource endpoint for its exact patch schema. The server merges partial fields then validates the full document; slug/pageKey are immutable.

Operation.description: Only committed is completed. pending requires polling; failed/needs_recovery require receipt inspection and administrator recovery. A receipt is not search indexing or AI visibility evidence.

ActionBody.description: rollback requires revision. Protected lifecycle actions remain subject to administrator verification.

seo.description: home and site-chrome must use empty seo; their SEO is owned by settings.

blocks.description: Blocks must belong to pageKey, have unique IDs, and stay in increasing fixed template order. Internal hrefs only; runtime also checks fixed row/service slot counts.
